leads.title: Software Developer — AI & Automation

why.ar: كما أنه يذكر الحاجة إلى فهم واختبار وتصحيح الأكواد التي يولدها الذكاء الاصطناعي، وهو ما يفعله Moe في عمله.
why.en: This lead is an excellent fit for Moe as it seeks a developer who uses AI coding tools to build applications and automation, which is Moe's core approach to developing Android apps and AI agents. It also mentions the need to understand, test, and troubleshoot AI-generated code, which is integral to Moe's AI-assisted development process.

watch.ar: بما أن الوظيفة بدوام جزئي على LinkedIn، يجب التأكد من أنها مشروع مستقل وليست علاقة توظيف مستمرة.
watch.en: Since this is a part-time role on LinkedIn, Moe should confirm it is a project-based freelance contract and not an ongoing employment relationship.

leads.proposal:
You're seeking a resourceful developer to create working applications and automated workflows using AI coding tools. This aligns perfectly with my approach: I build native Kotlin Android apps and AI agents with AI-assisted development, where AI tools help write the code, and I manage the entire process from design to publishing. For example, my own daily AI research agent, Me.ai, is a native Android app that uses Gemini and web search for automation.

You can try my live apps here:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/developer?id=MonteCarlo+News24

Could you share more details about the specific applications or automated workflows you have in mind?

leads.title: Kotlin Developer

watch.ar: هذا إعلان وظيفة على LinkedIn؛ يحتاج Moe لفتح الإعلان الكامل للتأكد من أنها فرصة عمل مستقلة/عقد، وليست وظيفة بدوام كامل.
watch.en: This is a LinkedIn job post; Moe needs to open the full post to confirm it's a freelance/contract opportunity, not a full-time employee position.

leads.proposal:
My services cover the full development spectrum, from concept to Google Play publishing and ongoing support. I build with AI-assisted development: I design, plan and test, and AI tools help write the code.

My app STACK! Tower Rush, a casual game, showcases my ability to create engaging and polished user experiences.

You can try my live apps here:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/developer?id=MonteCarlo+News24

leads.title: Buat Aplikasi Komunitas Android
leads.summary: Saya ingin membangun sebuah aplikasi komunitas atau sosial khusus untuk perangkat Android. Aplikasi ini harus memungkinkan pengguna membuat profil, bergabung atau membuat grup, berbagi postingan (teks, foto, dan video si

why.ar: المشروع يطلب تطبيق أندرويد أصلي (Native Kotlin) مع ميزات مجتمعية مثل ملفات تعريف المستخدمين والمجموعات والمشاركات والإشعارات الفورية، وكلها يمكن تنفيذها باستخدام Firebase. كما أنه يستخدم التطوير بمساعدة الذكاء الاصطناعي لزيادة الكفاءة.
why.en: The project requests a native Kotlin Android community app with features like user profiles, groups, posts, and real-time notifications, all of which can be implemented using Firebase. He also uses AI-assisted development for efficiency.

watch.ar: الميزانية (250-750 دولارًا أمريكيًا) قد تكون منخفضة قليلاً بالنسبة لنطاق تطبيق مجتمعي كامل مع تحميل الوسائط والإشعارات في الوقت الفعلي، لذا يجب إدارة توقعات العميل بشأن نطاق MVP. كما أن ذكر React Native كخيار قد يكون علامة حمراء، لكن Kotlin هو الخيار المفضل لموي.
watch.en: The budget ($250-750 USD) might be a bit low for the full scope of a community app with media uploads and real-time notifications, so client expectations for an MVP need to be managed. The mention of React Native as an option is a slight red flag, but Kotlin is also explicitly offered and is Moe's preference.

leads.proposal:
I understand you're looking to develop a dedicated Android community application, enabling users to create profiles, join groups, share content, and receive real-time notifications. My focus is on building robust native Kotlin Android apps with efficient Firebase backends for features like user authentication, database management, and push notifications. I leverage AI-assisted development to streamline the coding process, ensuring a high-quality product. For instance, my app Peace & Conflict 24 includes a news dashboard and live chat, demonstrating experience with community-focused features. I can deliver your app with a simple, modern UI/UX and a basic admin dashboard as requested.

You can try my live apps here:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/developer?id=MonteCarlo+News24

Could you share more details about the specific types of media users will be able to upload, and if there are any particular content moderation rules you envision for the admin dashboard?
